title: Do Med Agent Hub's date and medication rules still hold up on 15 unseen HIV patients?
summary: To make sure our clinical date-window, lab-trend, and prescription rules were not overfitted to our three development charts, we drew 15 fresh, previously unseen HIV patient records and asked 8 clinical questions per patient (120 answers per setup, 240 total). Both OpenMRS's built-in ChartSearchAI and Med Agent Hub's rule-checked single-model path ran Google Gemma 4 12B and were graded blind by two independent AI judges.
takeaway: The improvements generalized cleanly to unseen patients: Med Agent Hub outscored built-in ChartSearchAI 81.5 to 75.3/100 across all 120 questions, cut unsafe answers by two-thirds (3 vs. 9), reduced invented facts sixfold (2 vs. 12), and eliminated all six time-window overreach errors seen on built-in ChartSearchAI.
